products.title: Enebe Spitfire Black 12k 2025 - Enebe
products.description:

La ENEBE SPITFIRE BLACK 12K 2025 que tenemos en oferta es una version mejorada de la Enebe Spitifire 2024, con diseño de color más serio y elegante. Como siempre, palas Enebe de gama alta fabricadas con los mejores materiales y así ofrecer un producto para los usuarios mas exigentes.

En cuanto al diseño podemos ver un acabado mate liso, muy solicitado por los usuarios en la temporada pasada.

La pala ENEBE SPITFIRE BLACK 12k 2025 esta enfocada hacia jugadores que buscan una pala completa, con estética cuidada y una composición y fabricación aplicadas hacia un producto versatil, duradero y cómo de usar. Un padelero de nivel medio alto que sabe cuales son sus punto fuertes en ataque y defensa.

PLAY STYLE

A medium-high level padel player who knows what his strengths are in attack and defense.

products.title: Siux Viking Iv - Siux
products.description:
SIUX VIKING IV - A versatile, teardrop-shaped, oversized racket for a complete player. A very reliable mid-range alternative to continue improving. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SIUX VIKING IV is an ideal racket to improve our shots. It helps a lot to push the ball, thanks in part to its teardrop format and high ball output, which is given by its soft EVA rubber. A padel racket with great value for money.

PLAYER TYPE

This padel racket is a safe and reliable alternative for intermediate level players.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The main features of the SIUX VIKING IV are:

- Teardrop format, which gives us medium balance and an enlarged sweet spot, this being in the center pulling towards the upper part of the face.

- Composition of 100% fiberglass and Eva Soft Rubber. This combination provides a greater ball output. Increases control both from the background and from the net.

- 38 mm thick profile.

- Special bridge that acts as reinforcement to stabilize the structure or also reduces vibrations.
